description.value: Bonsor Recreation Complex is a large municipal recreation facility operated by the City of Burnaby, situated in the dense Metrotown neighbourhood near a major SkyTrain interchange. It offers a swimming pool, gymnasium, weight and cardio rooms, a martial arts studio, and arts and music studios under one roof. The facility is a hub of community programming for the broader Burnaby area.
